title: mirror is fine but suction cup fails easily
text:
mirror is fine but suction cup fails easily. The suction cup lasts about a minute or two before releasing. (Unless you stand it up on a horizontal surface like a counter)
The mirror quality is decent. The bending arm holds in place ok - not great, but not bad.
It is lightweight plastic (which isn't a bad thing for a suction mirror).
It had fallen many times (because the suction cup releases) but it hasn't broken. So really the only problem with it at all is the suction cup.

product_metadata.title: Push to Lock Strong Suction Extendable & Adjustable Double Sided Cosmetics Vanity Mirror for Bath, Bathroom, and Shower – Stainless Steel Chrome
